description: Card, as the implementation ships it.

curated.by: scaffold --from=code, read from card.js, card.css, card.d.ts

props.name: variant
props.notes: The visual variant of the card.

props.name: density
props.notes: The density of the card, controlling internal spacing and gaps.

props.name: titleAsLink
props.notes: Indicates the consumer has wrapped their `title` slot content in a real link. Extends that link's hit area to cover the card surface while leaving navigation entirely consumer-owned; Card accepts no `href`.

props.name: selectable
props.notes: Makes the card focusable and captures surface clicks (excluding nested interactive targets) to dispatch a `swc-card-click` event, independent of `titleAsLink`. selection model determines the appropriate role.

props.name: collection
props.notes: Optional collection images. Assign each image to the slot.

props.name: media
props.notes: Optional overlay content (e.g. a badge or avatar) layered over the preview/collection media region.
